intro: Every field is optional. Checks run as you type and never stop you saving.
hint.specialLivery: Only real special liveries and stickers
hint.chooseAirport: Choose the airport first, so the time is stored with its UTC offset
hint.notSaved: {typed, select, yes {Not saved until {code} is added as an airport} other {Not saved until the airport is chosen}}
unknownCode: {kind, select, airport {Not a known airport code} other {Not a known airline code}}
operator: Not an airline: saved as an operator
section.timesIntro: Takeoff and landing, in local time at each airport. A takeoff after midnight goes on the next day.
section.privateIntro: Kept in your data only. Never sent to a lookup or an agent check, and left out of exports unless you include them.
more: More: seat, class, gate, livery, notes, ticket
